criteria.requirement: Add textdistance.retrieval Match and extract(query, choices, scorer, k=5, direction="distance", threshold=None, max_candidates=None). Stream (id,value) records through the actual scorer; maintain O(k) scored result storage with explicit lower-is-better distance or higher-is-better similarity, inclusive threshold and input-order stable ties. Return original id/value/score/index without comparing IDs or merging duplicates. k=0 must not consume choices. Bad score/nonfinite/bool values or insufficient candidate budget raise rather than return an apparently complete partial ranking. Keep scoring primitives unchanged and support ordinary callables and real built-in algorithms.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
